title: Gateway terminal status becomes visible only after it is durable
user_story: As a researcher (and CI) I must never see a provider request reported failed/completed while its durable record still says ready/running, so restarts, the API and research steps agree.

requirements.description: Every terminal gateway update (worker completion, worker crash, refusal, prelaunch failure, ready-cancel) is persisted before it is published on the shared in-memory record.

nonfunctional: No change to statuses, errors or answers produced
No test, assertion or threshold relaxed
outputs: Durable request record consistent with readers
postconditions: Disk and memory agree whenever a terminal status is observed
acceptance_criteria: Reader never observes a terminal status absent from disk under a slow write

scenarios.expected: With a 0.4 s terminal write, the first terminal status a reader sees is already on disk
Partial answer with error is a failed durable request
Existing session history is never overwritten

recovery: Revert gateway._finish and the final-status local in _run_inner. TASK-GATEWAY-DURABLE-661, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real gateway, files and threads in disposable data; vendor transport is a scripted fixture.

review.method: Same-agent review (not independent): every terminal write path, cancel interplay, readers polling get().

tdd.scope: RED: committed gateway (HEAD) with the new test: 1/1 FAIL [(failed, ready)]. GREEN: fixed gateway: 1/1 PASS.
